description: Positive contrast to the narrow-gutter cases: a 40pt gutter, above assemble.rs's MIN_CUT_FRACTION (3% of a 600pt-wide page = 18pt). Blocks are authored in naive top-to-bottom/left-to-right emit order (row-major, interleaving the two columns) -- the same degraded order Stage 1's baseline would produce. Because the gutter clears the threshold, xy_cut_order's vertical cut fires, recovering column-major reading order (left column fully before right). This demonstrates the roadmap's predicted reading-order edit-distance degradation (Stage 1, naive order vs. ground truth) alongside its recovery (post-assemble_reading_order, residual distance 0) in one case.
